scope.description: Whole ngspice application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Circuit definition, device models, DC/AC/transient and other analyses, nonlinear devices, behavioural modelling and result exploration.

coverage.rationale: DC/AC and first-order RC workflows now include useful frequency-grid and electrical characterisation decisions. General transient, nonlinear device/model, noise, distortion and scripting families still exclude most upstream SPICE breadth.

scope.description: Declared ideal linear networks with sampled voltage/gain/phase/current/power/loading intent and explicit phasor conventions.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Network topology, units, log-grid density, passive sign, RMS/peak convention and performance bounds express circuit intent without native control scripts or manual table calculations. Derived quantities retain their native-voltage/native-source-current basis.

limitations: Bounded ideal linear elements and one RC transient family; no semiconductors or arbitrary models/netlists; sampled acceptance is not a continuous-envelope guarantee.

Editorial estimate of workflow breadth and abstraction, not an exhaustive native API denominator. Fresh bounded native electrical cases are recorded separately; qualification freshness and local runtime availability remain independent.
